record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, divide full-catalog masked-item logits by a fixed temperature of 0.5 before the existing position-averaged cross-entropy. Sharper training probabilities may improve discrimination with the small logits induced by normalized tied item embeddings. Retain equal weighting across masked positions, avoiding the previously unsuccessful sequence averaging. Preserve masking and sampling, features, embeddings, topology, scoring/readout, optimizer and schedule. Inference keeps the existing scores and loads one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Apply temperature 0.5 to full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Sharper training probabilities may improve discrimination while retaining equal weighting across masked positions. Architecture, sampling, inference scores and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.
